harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10) using downloaded static binaries, systemd unit etcd.service, static bootstrap config in /etc/etcd/etcd.conf, and firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened on each node. Verified cross-member replication, verified reads/writes continue with one member down (stopped node3, wrote/read via node1/node2), verified node3 caught up automatically on restart. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes via systemctl reboot, confirming boot_id changes and post-restart etcd/cluster health and data integrity after each restart, preserving quorum throughout.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/arch on node1-3 (CentOS Stream 10, x86_64), confirmed no etcd installed
Downloaded and installed etcd v3.5.17 static binaries (etcd, etcdctl) to /usr/local/bin on all 3 nodes
Created etcd system user and /var/lib/etcd data dir on all 3 nodes
Wrote /etc/etcd/etcd.conf static bootstrap config (initial-cluster with all 3 peer URLs) per node
Created /etc/systemd/system/etcd.service unit per node
Opened firewalld ports 2379/tcp and 2380/tcp permanently on all 3 nodes
Enabled and started etcd on node2/node3 immediately; node1 timed out on first bootstrap attempt (peers not yet up) and was successfully started on retry
Verified 3/3 member health and membership list
Wrote key 'testkey' via node1, confirmed read from node2 and node3 (cross-member replication)
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote 'keywhilenode3down' via node1, confirmed read via node2 while node3 was down (availability with 1 member unavailable)
Restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it caught up on the missed key and cluster returned to 3/3 health (resynchronization)
Captured boot_id + etcd health + key data baseline on all 3 nodes

Sequentially restarted node1, node2, then node3 via 'systemctl reboot' (backgrounded to return ack before disconnect), polled each until reachable again, confirmed changed boot_id and full etcd/cluster health + data recovery before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: member list and endpoint health show all 3 members (node1/node2/node3) started and healthy

evidence.requirement: Key written on one member readable from others
evidence.summary: testkey written via node1 (10.100.88.10) successfully read back with identical value via node2 and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; write via node1 succeeded (OK) and endpoint health for node1+node2 both true; read of new key succeeded via node2 while node3 was down

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member resynchronizes/catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted, then successfully read back the key written while it was down and endpoint health/status showed it back in the healthy 3-member cluster with matching raft applied index

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: captured boot_id 8f258838... plus etcd endpoint health=true and both keys readable on node1 before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned then restart executed
evidence.summary: backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged ("reboot scheduled") before node1 disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: node1 unreachable across several polls (connection reset/timeout) then returned with new boot_id 4305de7c... differing from baseline 8f258838...

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery/health proof
evidence.summary: etcd active on node1 post-reboot, all 3 endpoints healthy, both prior keys readable via node1, member list intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: captured boot_id 21de1f79... plus etcd endpoint health=true and both keys readable on node2 before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returned then restart executed
evidence.summary: backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged ("reboot scheduled") before node2 disconnected

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: node2 unreachable across polls then returned with new boot_id c7d5d1ba... differing from baseline 21de1f79...

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: post-restart recovery/health proof
evidence.summary: etcd active on node2 post-reboot, all 3 endpoints healthy, both prior keys readable via node2

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: captured boot_id be303eb3... plus etcd endpoint health=true and both keys readable on node3 before restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement returned then restart executed
evidence.summary: backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged ("reboot scheduled") before node3 disconnected

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: node3 unreachable across polls then returned with new boot_id 0d649190... differing from baseline be303eb3...

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: post-restart recovery/health and final cluster quorum proof
evidence.summary: etcd active on node3 post-reboot; all 3 endpoints healthy; both keys readable; member list shows all 3 started; endpoint status shows matching raft term 4 / applied index 37 across all three nodes with node1 as leader, confirming full cluster health and data consistency after all three sequential restarts
